details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8470-8498 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Invalid or uninspectable final_merge_pr values and PR fetch failures only emit warnings and leave the project in in_progress/pending indefinitely.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers observed the same warn-and-continue path with no terminal escalation or dead-lettering, so a permanently bad state keeps retrying on every poll tick.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8488-8490 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A pinned final_merge_pr causes a fresh REST read on every poll tick with no cache or backoff.
  WHY: The reviewer says this creates steady API/rate-limit pressure for long-lived externally merged projects until the tracking issue is manually closed.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8499-8519 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The temp-file + mv state update is not coordinated, so concurrent pollers can observe torn or inconsistent state.
  WHY: Both reviewers noted the write is done without locking or an atomic marker, which can expose partially applied transitions to other workers.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8501-8522 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The durable state write happens before the completion side effects, so a failure in the callback/comment/label/Telegram chain can leave the project marked complete with only some side effects applied.
  WHY: Deepseek flagged the unguarded release callback as a mid-iteration abort under set -e, while the others flagged the broader lack of retry/atomicity after the state file is already persisted.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8519-8525 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The external-finalize continue does not prevent the later same-tick terminal-skip path from firing under some label/reassignment scenarios, so completion side effects can run twice.
  WHY: The reviewer says the per-issue continue only exits the current loop and a later re-read of PROJECT_STATUS can still reach the merge_conflict/validation paths on the same tick.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8526-8540 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The sync-block guard skips several terminal states but not validating or validation-fixing, so external-finalize can still call sync_default_into_integration_branch for those projects.
  WHY: Deepseek notes that if that sync call hits a merge conflict on a still-validating project with an integration branch, it can incorrectly transition the project to merge_conflict and interrupt validation.

- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:~8154-8287 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: There is no runtime _run_poller test that exercises the validation-fixing exclusion path through the external-finalize block.
  WHY: Qwen notes the static guard covers the string check, but there is no behavioral test proving a pinned final_merge_pr still reaches mark_validation_complete for status="validation-fixing".

- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8154-8287 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test hard-codes implementation details and literal jq/string needles, so non-behavior-changing refactors will break it.
  WHY: X-ai says the test anchors exact fragments such as the TRACKING_LABELS→sync_default_into_integration_branch boundary, _fetch_pr_json, .final_merge_pr // empty, .merged_at != null, and set_tracking_phase_label "ai:merged".
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8526-8540 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The sync-block guard at line 8530-8533 excludes complete, failed, merge_conflict, and validation-failed but does not exclude validating or validation-fixing, so external-finalize can still call sync_default_into_integration_branch for those projects.
  WHY: If sync_default_into_integration_branch encounters a merge conflict on a validating project whose integration branch still exists, it can incorrectly transition the project to merge_conflict and interrupt the validation flow.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8497-8498
  PROBLEM: When _fetch_pr_json returns {} (API failure, PR not found) or _jq_field cannot extract valid fields, the block emits a ::warning:: and leaves final_merge_status=pending.
  WHY: On every subsequent poll tick, the same PR is re-fetched and the same warning fires, producing repeated API calls with no escape path; a permanently unresolvable PR would generate one API call and one warning per poll tick indefinitely.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8506-8519
  PROBLEM: handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed is called without || true unlike post_state_comment, so a non-zero exit can terminate the script mid-iteration.
  WHY: Under set -euo pipefail, a failure in that function can stop the label/comment/Telegram cleanup from running even though the state on disk was already persisted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8486-8492 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When final_merge_pr is corrupted (non-numeric), the code warns and continues, but the project stays in in_progress with no terminal state transition.
  WHY: If the state file has a corrupted final_merge_pr value that is non-numeric, the project remains stuck in in_progress forever, cycling on wave-dispatch without any operator-visible escalation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8501-8519 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq temp-file write followed by mv is not protected by file locking, so concurrent poller workers or later steps can observe partial state on disk.
  WHY: A race condition could leave STATE_FILE with inconsistent state and cause the orchestrator to retry the transition repeatedly or miss side effects on the next tick.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8470-8474 and 8490-8493 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both the non-numeric final_merge_pr path and the PR-fetch-failure path only emit a ::warning:: and continue the loop, leaving the project in in_progress with final_merge_status="pending".
  WHY: A corrupted state file or transient GitHub API glitch leaves the project permanently stuck in in_progress with a pinned but unusable final_merge_pr, and the wave-dispatch BLOCKED alerts resume on the next poll.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8501-8519 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If post_state_comment, handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed, set_tracking_phase_label, or post_tracking_comment fails mid-sequence, the state file was already written, leaving an inconsistent half-applied transition.
  WHY: The side effects become visible in the issue thread and Telegram while state says complete, producing operator confusion and a desynchronized system state.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8506-8514 and 8515-8522 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The state file is persisted before any of the completion side effects fire, so if one of them fails the project is already marked complete and the operator-visible signals may be partially or entirely missing.
  WHY: An API transient error in post_tracking_comment or tg_send_msg leaves the project in complete status with no tracking-issue comment explaining the transition and stale Telegram alerts still pinned, and the next poll tick skips the block entirely.

- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:~8154-8287 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: No runtime test covers the validation-fixing exclusion path.
  WHY: The static regression guard asserts that != "validation-fixing" appears in the window, but there is no _run_poller invocation that exercises status="validation-fixing" through the external-finalize block's exclusion gate.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8486-8489 and 8496-8498 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both the non-numeric final_merge_pr path and the PR-fetch-failure path only emit ::warning:: and continue the loop, leaving the project in in_progress indefinitely.
  WHY: If the state file carries a persistently corrupted final_merge_pr, the poller will silently warn on every tick with no terminal state or tracking comment escalation; a configurable warn counter or single-run guard would reduce the damage.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8499-8505 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The state update uses a temp-file + mv pattern with only best-effort cleanup and no surrounding lock or atomic marker.
  WHY: Concurrent poller workers can read a partially-written or torn state file, causing duplicate side-effects, re-entrant external-finalize on the next tick, or the wave-dispatch gate continuing to fire.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8470-8474 and 8490-8493 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both the non-numeric final_merge_pr guard and the unable-to-inspect-PR path only emit a warning and continue, with no terminal state written.
  WHY: A corrupted state file or transient GitHub API glitch leaves the project permanently stuck in in_progress with a pinned but unusable final_merge_pr, and the wave-dispatch BLOCKED alerts resume on the next poll.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8519-8525 together with the later terminal-skip block (≈ line 8914 in the surrounding loop) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After external-finalize mutates on-disk state and sets the in-memory variable, the continue only exits the current per-tracking-issue iteration.
  WHY: Under certain label or reassignment scenarios, a later re-read of PROJECT_STATUS can still fire on the same tick and duplicate handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed, set_tracking_phase_label, and Telegram messages.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8488-8490 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When a final_merge_pr remains pinned and final_merge_status=pending, every poll tick performs a fresh REST call via _fetch_pr_json.
  WHY: For long-lived projects that an operator has externally merged, this adds a steady background API cost and rate-limit pressure on every orchestrator poll cycle until the tracking issue is manually closed.

- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8154-8287 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regression guard hard-codes literal string needles for both placement and implementation details, so any non-behavior-changing edit will break these tests.
  WHY: The test anchors exact fragments like TRACKING_LABELS=... -> sync_default_into_integration_branch, _fetch_pr_json, .final_merge_pr // empty, .merged_at != null, and set_tracking_phase_label "ai:merged".
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
